Whistlestop for Windows (beta)
==============================

HF keyboard chat, file transfer and group Roundtables over the Mercury
modem, with the "whistle" CQ. This is a beta: please report what goes wrong.

Needs: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Nothing to install for Whistlestop itself.


1. Start it
-----------
Unzip this folder anywhere and run whistlestop.exe.

- Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC" because the
  program isn't signed. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".
- A console window opens beside the app. Leave it open: closing it closes
  Whistlestop.
- Settings are kept in %APPDATA%\Whistlestop (whistlestop.toml).


2. Try Demo mode first
----------------------
Whistlestop starts in Demo mode: a simulated radio, band, modem and a demo
station, K7BOT. Nothing is transmitted. Call CQ, search, chat and send a
file with K7BOT to learn the screen. Press "Guide" in the top bar for the
full manual (USER-GUIDE.md in this folder is the same text), and "? Help"
to have every control explain itself when you point at it.


3. Set up your station
----------------------
Follow "Setting up your station" in the Guide. In short:

- Install the Mercury modem: https://github.com/Rhizomatica/mercury/releases
  (the Windows installer or zip).
- In Whistlestop's Settings: your callsign, untick Demo mode, and choose a
  radio connection. "Direct CAT (built in)" needs nothing else and shares
  the radio with Mercury at 127.0.0.1:4532.
- Set Mercury's radio to Hamlib model 2 (NET rigctl) at 127.0.0.1:4532,
  its sound card to the radio's USB audio, ports 8300 and 8100. Start it
  with -G so Whistlestop can set the transmit level.
- Start Mercury after Whistlestop, then click the red Mercury pill to
  connect.

First test into a DUMMY LOAD at low power. Watch the ALC: it should barely
move (a bar or two). Then try the air.

Encryption is OFF by default. It is NOT legal on amateur bands in the US
(47 CFR 97.113(a)(4)) and most other countries: leave it off.


4. Report problems
------------------
https://github.com/NR5P/whistlestop/issues

Please say:
- your radio and how it's connected;
- the Whistlestop and Mercury versions;
- what you did, what you expected, and what happened;
- the lines from the Log tab around that time.
